rules.problem: Page says 'Check glucose, temperature and pupils' but check_for contains no glucose or temperature measurements (hypoglycaemia <3/<4 diabetes, >=11.1, <=35, >=38). Also the anaphylaxis symptoms are listed as check_for items although the page only says check for anaphylaxis (pointer to p28); acceptable pre-screen pattern but note.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible anaphylaxis with sudden decreased consciousness
rules.problem: Structure faithful (sudden DOC AND any of list); possible is right for 'check for anaphylaxis'. Allergen exposure drops 'within the past few hours' window.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable shock with decreased consciousness and glucose ≥ 11.1
rules.problem: Faithful to 'SBP<80, pulse>=100, RR>30, weakness, shock likely' under glucose >= 11.1; probable matches 'likely'.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible meningitis with decreased consciousness and temperature ≥ 38
Diagnose probable drug overdose with decreased consciousness and dilated pupils
rules.problem: Faithful ('Stimulant or other drug overdose likely'); diagnosis name drops 'stimulant or other' qualifier, fine.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable poisoning with decreased consciousness
rules.problem: Reasonable reading of the pupils tree (pinpoint with drug use/RR<12/secretions/twitching, or dilated). Pinpoint branch grouping slightly ambiguous in the diagram; the dilated branch reaches poisoning only via overdose.
Urgent justified by 'Give urgent attention' and 'Refer urgently'. Does not reference the probable diagnoses via active_condition as the house standard suggests, minor.

summary: No invented content found: every condition traces to the page. Main gaps are coverage, not fidelity: glucose and temperature thresholds are never checked for, and the page's hypoglycaemia (<3 / <4 in diabetes), hypothermia (<=35), hyperthermia (>40, malaria) and unequal/poorly-reactive pupils branches have no rules. Minor imprecision: synonym concepts (Responds to pain, Unresponsive, Impairment of mental alertness) are not on the page, and the allergen 'past few hours' window is dropped.
